parsed.why: Most Protective tier; shield law, public-accommodations ban, GI hate-crime coverage, gender-identity custody policy, open documents. National passport/entry regime still binds, capping well below Low Risk.

Sanctuary law, nondiscrimination, hate-crime coverage and pro-trans court rulings, but two recent trans woman killings with perpetrator at large and unsourced visitor coverage of sanctuary law offset slightly.

Hostile division layers: school birth-sex facility ban, surgery-only birth certificates, hate-crime statute excluding gender identity, religious-exemption service refusals, veto override. Worst local regime, compounding the restrictive national framework.

Low-Risk group, governor vetoed bathroom bills, employment protections; but hate-crime statute omits gender identity, trans panic defense alive, youth restrictions, Pride dissolved — modest lift over hostile parent, weak local floor.

Most Protective tier plus visitor-facing wins: public-accommodation ban, GI hate-crime reporting machinery, self-declared documents and X markers, shield law. Unenforced sodomy statutes are tangential; national border regime still caps the score.
